column2: TITLE THEME. Slow noir jazz ballad (art director answer: "Noir jazz lento"). 66–72 bpm, swing 0.12–0.18, D minor/harmonic. sax lead (leitmotif stated clearly in the first 2 bars, then developed), upright walking bass, piano comping (accIns piano, acc pad or stab), kit jazz with brushes (b) and soft ride, sparse. fx.hall 0.2–0.3. Loop ≈ 60 s (≈ 17–18 bars at 70 bpm). Sections A A' B A'' with a short piano-only breath somewhere. Moody rainy night, mysterious, elegant.

ZONE 1 (early stage). Fantasy, MYSTERIOUS, no mafia/jazz flavour ("sin tema mafia, fantasía pura"). 84–90 bpm, straight (swing 0). D dorian or minor. harp arpeggios (accIns harp, acc arp8), strings pad, flute or celesta lead carrying the leitmotif slowly in augmentation, cello bass (bassIns cello or upright, bass pedal/rootfifth), very light orch kit (shaker h, frame drum b) or no drums. fx.hall 0.35. Loop ≈ 60 s. Calm wonder with an undercurrent of mystery.

ZONE 2 (mid stage, catacombs). Fantasy, TENSE. 100–108 bpm, E phrygian or harmonic minor (transpose the leitmotif). cello ostinato bass (bassIns cello, bass line with b), strings stabs, choir pad, low timpani pulse (kit orch, k on beats, b frame drum syncopation), celesta or harp high fragments of the leitmotif. fx.hall 0.3. Loop ≈ 60 s. Unease, building tension, darker than zone 1.

MINIBOSS. Fast ~140 bpm, D harmonic minor, epic fantasy battle. kit orch driving (timpani k, snare s with ghosts, cymbal o on section starts), strings 16th ostinato (acc arp16, accIns strings), cello/upright bass rootfifth/octave, choir + sax-free lead: use strings or choir lead stating the leitmotif heroically, then a B section with call & response. fx.hall 0.2. Loop ≈ 60 s (~35 bars). Relentless but musical.

GAME OVER JINGLE, exactly ONE bar at 80 bpm (= 3 s), "loop": false. Like a souls-like death sting: kit orch with one accented timpani hit X at step 0 and cymbal o at step 0; choir lead holding a low D minor chord tone (D4:16 or A4:16), cello bass D2 held, acc pad with accIns strings on Dm(add9) or Dm/F. fx.hall 0.45. Heavy, final, solemn.

TITLE STING (plays when the player presses the first key), 1 bar at 90 bpm (~2.7 s), "loop": false. Noir: piano + upright bass hit on step 0 (Dm(add9) or Dm9), sax short rising figure from the leitmotif (A4 D5 F5 A5) landing on A5 held, kit jazz with an accented ride/cymbal on step 0. fx.hall 0.3.

BOSS DEFEATED FANFARE, 2 bars at 100 bpm (~4.8 s), "loop": false, D major (Picardy turn of the leitmotif: D5 F#5 A5 ... D6). strings + choir, accIns strings acc stab then pad, kit orch: timpani rolls (k with x on several 16ths) and cymbal o on bar 2 step 0. fx.hall 0.35. Triumphant, short.
